$comment: Self-activation (rk3): a plain `git clone` carries .continuity/ but nothing tells Claude Code to read it. These project-scoped hooks run the repo's own committed bundles, so a collaborator gets auto-resume and auto-capture without installing the plugin. Developers who DO have the plugin installed register the same hooks twice; both hooks de-duplicate per session (src/core/once.ts), so the double registration is harmless.
